rows.en: This is... Hey, look closer, it's a Feilong Flag!
This is... Hey, look closer, it's a Feilong Flag!
This is... a Feilong Flag, by the look of it.
This is... a Feilong Flag, by the look of it.
Huh. So that freak was using this thing as the stick for the ice pop?
Can't be helped. Guess I'll take this back as a souvenir.
Obtained "Feilong Flag".
Completed the quest "The Ultimate Ice Pop".
Masurao has sent 00 a challenge letter. Take 00 to Museum 1F in Shocker Cube.
So you have come...
You! Masurao!
I longed to see you... How I longed to see you, Gundam!!
I believed that with information on Veda as bait, I would surely meet you!
Don't tell me... You were behind the Veda information!?
Precisely! That information was meant to lure out the Gundam.
Out of my way! I have no time to waste on the likes of you!
To be brushed aside so coldly... Then I shall hold your gaze captive!
Today, I am a being who surpasses even Asura!!
This chance to meet you, at long last...
As a Virgo, I cannot help but sense a sentimental destiny in it.
Huh? What the hell's that guy talkin' about?
Huh? What is that guy going on about?
Hm? What is that man talking about?
What's that guy babbling about?
Huh? What are you talking about?
What is that guy talking about?
What is that guy talking about?
What is that guy talking about?
What is that guy talking about?
What is that guy talking about?
What is that guy talking about?
What is that guy talking about?
What is that guy talking about?
What is he saying?
Yes, the Gundam has captivated my heart! This feeling... it is truly love!
Love!?
But love, once transcended, turns to hatred. And so I will defeat you! Of my own will!
What!? You are distorted!
It was you who made me so! The very existence of the Gundam!
That is why I will defeat you all. The world matters not. Of my own will!
And then I will surpass the Gundam! That shall be the proof that I live!
Shut up! Like hell we're gonna get beaten 'cause of your selfish whims!
Like hell we're goin' down over your screwy logic!
No way are we getting beaten just to satisfy your desire!
Like hell we'll go down for your selfish whims!
We have no intention of being defeated for your selfish whims!
Like hell we'll go down for your selfish whims!
We won't be defeated by this so-called love of yours!
We won't be defeated by this so-called love of yours!
We will not be defeated for your selfish whims!
We will not be defeated for your selfish whims!
We will not be defeated for your selfish whims!
That's just ego! We won't be beaten by the likes of you!
We won't be beaten for your selfishness!
Then I'll kill you.
That distortion of yours! I will sever it myself!!
Ngh... My particle reserves are nearly spent!
I shall say it boldly, Gundam! Remember this well!
00 must be in the party to progress this quest.
Completed the quest "Veda Classified Data".
Pigmon has come to the base again. It seems to have information on Alien Baltan.
Just like before, Maganac and Pigmon were there.
Au-au!! Au-au!!
This again? Hey, get out that Pan-Space Interpreter from last time.
I've been waiting for you.
It seems Pigmon has gotten hold of new information again.
Looks like Alien Baltan is moving ahead with a plan to invade the base this time-pi.
Alien Baltan? Them again?
But this time there's not just one. It sounds like there are lots of Alien Baltans-pi.
Pigmon, where are the Alien Baltans?
North of the quarry in Hideout Cube-pi.
Ah. Where the Ultra Warriors were crucified, huh.
IF YOU GO, YOU MUST NOT FORGET TO GO TOGETHER WITH ULTRA WARRIORS.
Thank you for the information, Pigmon.
This time, multiple Alien Baltans have been confirmed.
Be careful heading north of the quarry-pi.
Ultraman must be in the party to progress this quest.
Please bring the Ultra Warriors with you. This request concerns them as well.
Fo, fo, fo, fo, fo...
So you've shown up again!! Alien Baltan!!

notes.note: Quest014.bla, mapping N+1 (as quest_015). Rows 166-169 end the leader block +154+pt (Pt_Chara_Check order 5,4,3,2,1,14,15,13,11,12,6,7,8,9, then 00): 166 Zeta, 167 God Gundam, 168 Wing Zero, 169 00. 166/167 reuse quest_015's English for the identical row 165; 168/169 curt 'you na' wording.
Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36, +169). 'Saki no yatsu' = Sweets Dopant (g=f); 'that freak' avoids a pronoun, as quest_015 did. 'Ice cream' kept to match the quest title.
Not referenced by Quest014.bla (script goes +169 straight to OkWin). Rough speech; read as Ankh continuing. Speaker inferred.
Item message matches QuestMess 0.515 English. Not referenced by the script (OkWin +174/+175 = rows 175/176; 176 does not exist).

Quest description row. Source location differs from QuestMess 0.71 (this row says Shocker Cube Museum 1F; QuestMess says Veda Cube Terminal Unit); followed this row's source. 'Museum 1F' matches the existing location label.

Quest015.bla mapping N+1 (+3 = row 4 under a '???' name box, i.e. Masurao before he is seen; +4 00 = row 5; +5-6, +8, +10-13 Masurao; +7, +9 00). Masurao in formal no-contraction speech as in story_083; his lines here are Graham Aker quotes from Gundam 00 (love/hatred, Asura, Virgo, 'I dare say').
'Otomeza' = the zodiac sign Virgo (Graham's line), not the Virgo mobile doll.

Leader block 15-28 (+14+pt), Pt_Chara_Check order: 15 Momotaros, 16 Shotaro, 17 OOO, 18 Zero, 19 Mebius, 20 God Gundam, 21 Black RX, 22 Rider 1, 23 Ultraman, 24 Seven, 25 Taro, 26 Nu, 27 Zeta, 28 Wing Zero. Identical Japanese kept identical. Masurao g=m, so 'that guy/he'.
Mebius: no subject or pronoun in the source; read as a polite question put to Masurao directly ('What are you talking about?'). Could also be an aside to the party ('What is he talking about?').
00 (Setsuna): 'distorted' for the series' distortion motif, as in earlier slices; row 50 same.
Masurao shifts from 'kimi' (00) to 'kimi-tachi' (the whole party): 'you all'.

Leader block 36-49 (+35+pt), same order as 15-28. Dropped subject of 'taosarete tamaru ka' restored as 'we' (Masurao just vowed to defeat them all). 36 Momotaros, 37 Shotaro, 38 OOO ('desire'), 39/41 Zero/God Gundam (same Japanese), 40 Mebius (polite), 42/43 RX/Rider 1 ('so-called love'), 44-46 Ultraman/Seven/Taro, 47 Nu (Amuro's 'That's just ego!'), 48 Zeta, 49 Wing Zero (Heero's 'I'll kill you').
Masurao after battle (+51/+52). 'Ryuushi' = GN particles; kept as 'particle reserves'.
'Aete iu zo' echoes Graham's catchphrase ('I dare say'); rendered 'I shall say it boldly'. Parting threat 'oboete oku ga ii' = 'Remember this well!'.
OkWin +55 (no-00 branch). Format as quest_005/007.
OkWin +57; title from QuestMess 0.16.
Quest description row. Pigmon g=n ('it').

Quest016.bla mapping N+1: Maganac (79) +6/+7 = rows 7/8, Pigmon (267) +8/+10/+12/+17 = rows 9/11/13/18, Ankh (36) +9/+13 = rows 10/14, Ultraman (11) +11/+15 = rows 12/16, OkWin +18 = row 19, Baltan (266) +23 = row 24, Ultraman +24 = row 25. Rows 4, 5, 6, 15, 17 and 21 are not referenced (speakers inferred): 4 narration, 5 Pigmon's cry, 6 rough voice (Ankh-like), 15 Pigmon via the interpreter, 17 and 21 Maganac (polite).
Unreferenced. Device named descriptively in the source (all-universe translator), so 'universal translator' rather than the 'Pan-Space Interpreter' item name used in quest_010.
Pigmon's sentence-final 'ppi' as '-pi' per glossary style.
Same Japanese as DG_QUEST010 #0.22; same English.
Katakana interpreter speech: all caps, no contractions, as quest_010/011/017.
Unreferenced (no-Ultraman branch shows only the OkWin). Close to DG_QUEST010 #0.29 with 'mo' (also): 'as well'.
Baltan laugh in the comma form used by quest_011/quest_017 for the identical Japanese.
Ultraman (+24). Same English as quest_017 rows 26-29 (identical Japanese apart from a comma).

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers from Quest014/015/016.bla, all mapping TextIdOffset+N = row N+1. Leader blocks follow Pt_Chara_Check order. Unreferenced rows, speakers inferred: DG_QUEST014 171 (Ankh), DG_QUEST016 4/5/6/15/17/21. Uncertain: DG_QUEST015 #0.19 (Mebius addressing Masurao or the party); DG_QUEST015 #0.1 location differs from QuestMess (followed the source). Masurao voiced with Graham Aker quotes in formal speech. No new glossary names.
